resolvedOriginalFailure: Six real-handler browser cases, including mobile signup/reset, passed in CI.
newFailure: Mocked Google cancellation rendered its status before hydration. The retry click caused no request. CI trace ends with callback cancellation and the continuation GET; there is no second Google action POST.
localRegression: With 1000ms script latency at callback reloads, unchanged interactions fail the same Enter your password heading assertion.
fix: Wait for the new client router after cancellation and success callback reloads. Delay handler uses route.fallback so existing provider interception remains authoritative; no live provider contact.
